title: inga pedunculata
intro: Inga pedunculata, commonly known as the Inga tree or White Inga, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, particularly its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, and has been used to treat various health conditions, including cardiovascular diseases and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Inga pedunculata include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
